The '''''Unitive''''' was a [[Consular-class light cruiser/Legends|''Consular''-class cruiser]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] that was [[Captain/Legends|captained]] by [[Pietrangelo]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

In [[23 BBY/Legends|23 BBY]], at a deep-[[Realspace/Legends|space]] rendezvous point within the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]], Jedi Knights [[Bultar Swan/Legends|Bultar Swan]] and [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] oversaw, within the ''Unitive's'' [[Salon pod/Legends|salon pod]], salvage rights negotiations for the [[False Sun Runner|alleged]] ancient ''[[Sun Runner]]'' transport. The opposing parties involved in the dispute for acquisition of the transport were [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Rodd]] of [[Fondor/Legends|Fondor]], who arrived in his [[salvage hauler]], and the [[Margravine]] [[Quenelle]] of [[Nallastia]], known also to the [[Jungle/Legends|jungle]]-[[Moon/Legends|moon]] clans as the [[Skull Queen]], who arrived in her [[rescue runner]].
